The jugular venous pulse is elevated at 9 cm above the sternal angle. Auscultation of the lungs reveals clear breath sounds bilaterally. An ECG shows ST elevation in leads II, III, and aVF with reciprocal ST depression in leads I and aVL. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management?

A) IV furosemide B) IV isotonic fluid bolus C) Morphine and close observation D) IV nitrates
